defaultNotes: Female cutting phase (~1750–1800 kcal): prioritize protein (~140g), stay hydrated (2.5–3.5L), and weigh cooked meats and cooked carbs. Coffee without sugar is fine. Legs day emphasizes glutes (hip thrust + abduction). Choose one exercise option per row, keep form strict, and finish sessions with 20–30 minutes of cardio when energy allows. Use food substitutions to stay consistent without monotony.
